title: Crocodile Tail: A Tequila Martini
ldInstructionsRaw: Add all of the ingredients to a mixing glass filled with lots of ice. Strain into a frozen glass. Garnish with a floating nasturtium leaf. Squeeze a lime peel (peel side out) over the drink, dripping some juice both on the leaf and in the drink. Discard the lime peel.
NoteFor the mezcal, Eggleston says any single-varietal that isn’t espadin will work.
Freezer MartiniCombine 375ml dry vermouth, 375ml blanco vermouth, 64 oz. tequila, and 18 oz. filtered water in a bottle and store in the freezer. Add dashes of amaro and mezcal to order.
